snapshot_markdown:
**BCI Minerals (ASX: BCI)** — Iron and Steel Mining, West Perth, AU. 51 employees. Pivoting from iron ore royalties into the Mardie Salt & Potash Project on the Pilbara coast.

### Situational read
Heavy build-out phase. 81% construction complete on Mardie as of late April 2026, brine channel and crystallizer commissioned March 2026. Euroz Hartleys projects AU$250M EBITDA/year once operational. Currently burning cash: TTM operating loss of -$53.1M, EBITDA -$44.4M, net loss -$45.9M. Capex heavy with -$259.9M in investing activity TTM. Cyclone disruptions noted but project still on track per April 28 analyst note.

### Financials (USD, TTM ending Dec 31, 2025)
- Market Cap **$793.5M** (+48% YoY), Enterprise Value **$1.10B** (+92% YoY)
- Total Assets **$918.9M**, Total Debt **$373.4M** (up from $76.1M in FY2024), Total Equity **$517.3M**
- Debt/Equity 0.72 — leverage building fast as project nears commissioning

### Capital structure
$1.09B raised to date. Anchor financing: **$665.3M Project Financing closed Oct 2024**, 11-year term loan maturing Oct 2035. Lender syndicate: Westpac ($224.5M), Export Finance Australia ($108.5M), Export Development Canada, ICBC. Recent equity: $39.3M PIPE Mar 2024, $67.1M PIPE Jul 2023 from Indonesia Asahan Aluminium. Largest holder: Alkane Resources (Majority, since 2006).

### Recent activity (last 6 months)
Construction milestone announcements dominating news flow. Dec 2025 brought regulatory approvals for an optimised dredge strategy and AU$29M convertible note conversion. Feb 2026 H1 results showed widening loss but analyst tone has stayed positive on project progress.

### Top contacts for outreach
1. **David Boshoff** — Managing Director — davids.boshoff@bciminerals.com.au
2. **Steve Fewster** — CFO — sfewster@bciminerals.com.au
3. **Robert Mancini** — Chief Legal & Commercial Officer — rmancini@bciminerals.com.au

Main line: +61 (0)8 6311 3400

### Why they'd buy
Construction/commissioning phase = peak operational risk window. Cost overrun pressure, schedule pressure, contractor coordination. Cash burn means every operational efficiency matters. Lender oversight from a 4-bank syndicate adds governance discipline. Right time to pitch operational consulting.
